title: CBook
description: CBook adds 2 books: one copies items, the other temporarily clones items.
body: CBook adds two magic books to your server. CopyBook lets players copy another player’s held item and store it inside the book, then withdraw stored items later using a GUI menu. CloneBook gives a temporary clone of a player’s held item that expires after a set time and can revert back into the CloneBook. Includes permissions, cooldowns, blacklisted items, and strong anti-dupe/anti-tamper protection for temporary clones.
